Options API: props{}.description:
Type: Array<string> | Object
type: can be one of the following native constructors: `String`, `Number`, `Boolean`, `Array`, `Object`, `Date`, `Function`, `Symbol`, any custom constructor function or an array of those.

Options API: propsData{}.description:
Type: Object.
only respected in instance creation via `new`.
Pass props to an instance during its creation. This is primarily intended to make unit testing easier.

Options API: setup().description:
Vue 2.7+ (or the [@vue/composition-api](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@vue/composition-api) plugin on Vue 2.6 and below).
Entry point for the Composition API. Runs before `beforeCreate`, so `this` is not available; reach the instance through `getCurrentInstance().proxy` if you must.
The Vue 2.7 setup context is `{ attrs, listeners, slots, emit, expose }`.

Options API: emits[].description:
Vue 2.7+, **type-level only** — `vue` 2.7 accepts the option for `defineComponent` type inference but does not validate or strip declared events at runtime the way Vue 3 does.
Declares the events a component emits.

Options API: expose[].description:
**Vue 3 only — the `expose` component option does not exist in Vue 2.7.**
In Vue 2, call `expose()` from the setup context, or `defineExpose()` inside `<script setup>`.
Limits which instance properties a parent can reach through a template ref.
